name: mare-lean
description: The lean MCP door of Mare Liberum (no account, no key): 4 tools, read_page and think plus find_tools and call_tool, which reach every tool of the sea; its tool list measured 631 tokens instead of 9,695 for the open door's 55 tools (o200k_base, 2026-11-25). Plus a skill that tells the agent when to read a page again with since=, cut a JSON answer with fields=, fit a long page with budget=, and when /compress fits.
